text: In the paired m2-fixed N=128 arm (exp-20261013-231210-ae2c), the trajectory gives force R2 of about 0.68-0.70 at step 3000, against 0.763/0.789 here. That would be a drop of about 0.07-0.10, well past the 0.03 bound. If probes_final for those runs confirms a per-seed trained force R2 drop of at least 0.05, is the N=64 to N=128 force decline caused by losing the 1/r^2 part rather than the m2 factor, given that it persists with m2 fixed?
